authorisation: Product-Owner mission of 2026-09-26: finalise the product branding as OneGate (company: Semantics), move always-visible guidance behind a consistent lightbulb help drawer in the Guest Portal, Hotel Admin and Central, move the authoritative nightly validation from 03:10 to 06:00 Africa/Cairo, deliver through the protected PR path, and deploy to PRE-LIVE 172.21.60.25 and to Central 150.0.0.252. It did NOT authorise Go-Live, networking or topology change, PMS configuration or financial traffic, or any permission, authentication or security semantic change.

brand.wordmark: OneGate: 'One' bold in a green linear gradient (#0b7a3b -> #149c4a -> #3cc05a -> #8fdc5f), 'Gate' bold in solid black (#0a0a0a); set as type, on a light tile on dark surfaces so 'Gate' stays black. A gradient 'O' ring is the compact mark and the favicon. Company attribution: 'OneGate by Semantics'.
brand.where: Hotel Admin login, sidebar, title and favicon; Central login, sidebar, title and favicon; every guest page ends with a discreet, translated 'Wi-Fi by OneGate'. Every visible 'Velonet' now reads OneGate, or Semantics where the sentence is about the company (support, licence files, who to contact). Historical manifests and receipts keep their names.
brand.semantics_presentation: External demo hotel names in UI placeholders, examples, operator guides and test fixtures now read Semantics / Semantics Demo Hotel. Operational records were not changed: the site name Central assigned (shown in the Hotel Admin eyebrow) is untouched, and PRE-LIVE's saved portal hotel name -- set by a hotel operator to 'Hotel Name' before this delivery -- was left as the operator set it.

help_ux: components/help.tsx in both consoles (HelpTip, HelpSection, HelpList): a lightbulb beside a page or section title opens a Tips drawer. Every Hotel Admin screen (39) and every Central screen (12) carries exactly one page-level lightbulb; long descriptions became one sentence and explanatory paragraphs and neutral callouts moved into the drawers. Warnings about consequences, current-state warnings, why a control is disabled, errors, empty states, confirmation text and one-time-reveal warnings stay on the page. The guest portal gains an accessible lightbulb sheet (nonce script, focus trap, Esc, a no-JavaScript <details> fallback) with per-method tips in all six languages; errors, countdowns, notices, labels and short field hints stay visible.
portal_string_bound: portaldesign.MaxTranslationKeys raised from 120 to 160, because the portal now ships 130 translatable strings and an existing rule requires every shipped string to be overridable by a hotel. MaxBodyBytes (2 MB) is unchanged. edged, which enforces the bound on save, and portald were deployed together.
nightly_schedule: One cron '0 6 * * *' with timezone Africa/Cairo (was '10 3 * * *'). The schedule sanity check targets 06:00 local; an ignored timezone now shows as 06:00 UTC = 08:00 (winter, +120) or 09:00 (summer, +180) Cairo and is still refused by the 105-minute threshold. The delivery-protocol validator requires exactly '0 6 * * *'; the nightly negative suite (86 assertions) and the 366-night sweep are re-derived for 06:00. All four gates, the re-run mechanism and every protection are unchanged.
